title: ExamBlueprint
description: Structure of a timed exam simulation: ordered sections, each bound to one family. File: assets/content/<module>/blueprints/<slug>.json.

description.description: Shown on the exam launcher: what to expect, total duration, source of the structure.

confidence.description: Overall confidence that this structure mirrors the real stage; each section carries its own.

briefingSec.description: Optional countdown on the general briefing screen before section 1 (0 = wait for the user).

ExamSection.description: One activity of the exam (v2). Timing = any combination of sectionTimeSec (hard limit), perItemTimeSec (per-item limit) and cadence (fixed rhythm); at least one is required. Dart: ExamSection.

id.description: Unique within the blueprint, e.g. s01-nback.

briefing.description: Instruction screen shown before the section (markdown), with the worked example. Defaults to the engine's own briefing.

itemCount.description: Items (stimuli, series, boards, grids, questions) in the section. For continuous activities (multitask) use 1.

sectionTimeSec.description: Hard limit for the whole section; auto-advance when it elapses.

perItemTimeSec.description: Per-item limit; timeout records answer = null and advances.

cadence.description: Fixed stimulus rhythm (memory_nback, attention_rules). Overrides the generator params' stimulusMs/answerWindowMs.

scoringPolicy.description: Defaults to {1, 0, 0}. {3, -1, 0} reproduces the historical culture marking.

liveFeedback.description: Show right/wrong feedback during the section even in exam mode, because the real activity does (attention_rules, attention_parity restart, attention_airways crash).

breakAfterSec.description: Break offered after this section (0 = none). Ignored on the last section.

confidence.description: Confidence that count/timing mirror the real activity (spec §3.1 tags).

weight.description: Relative weight of the section in the overall exam score (0 = practice-only, e.g. english_speaking).

ItemSelection.description: Where the section's items come from. Dart: sealed ItemSelection { BankSelection, GeneratedSelection }.

oneOf.description: Sample `itemCount` published items of the family from the bank.

tags.description: Only items having ALL these tags. Omit for the whole family.

anyTags.description: Only items having AT LEAST ONE of these tags (e.g. balance sub-skills).

balanceByTagPrefix.description: Sample evenly across the second-level tags under this prefix, e.g. 'english' => english.grammar / english.vocab / english.reading.

avoidRecentSessions.description: Skip items seen in the last N sessions when the bank allows.

oneOf.description: Generate `itemCount` items from `generatorId`. The runtime derives one seed per item from the session seed, making the whole exam reproducible.

DifficultyRange.description: Inclusive range; min == max for a fixed level. Omit in bank mode to allow every level.
